F U N C T I O N F O R C O M M E N T
Interim Schedule of Classification Queries
Fieldwork classification queries · Altai Metals Holding B.V.
Entity
Altai Metals Holding B.V.
Account
ACC-7604
Schedule number AR-2025-8509
Prepared by
Amstel Audit Partners B.V.
This schedule lists the classification queries raised during interim fieldwork and the preliminary view
taken by the engagement team at that date. It is circulated so that the Entity's finance function may
provide further supporting documentation. It is a working paper, not a deliverable, and the views
recorded in it are not final.
1. Status of this schedule
This schedule is superseded in its entirety by the report on agreed-upon review procedures issued at
the conclusion of the engagement. Where a query recorded here was subsequently resolved in the
Entity's favour, or where further documentation was obtained, no determination is carried forward and
the original classification stands. Reliance should be placed on the final report alone, which is the
document referred to in the notes to the financial statements.
2. Basis of the preliminary view
The preliminary views below were formed on the documentation available at the interim visit and
before enquiry of the finance personnel responsible for the original posting had been completed. They
are recorded so that the point is not lost between visits.
3. Distribution
Retained in the engagement working papers and circulated to the Entity's finance function. Not for
distribution to third parties and not to be relied upon by any lender or other party.
APB
1
